roadmap.title: Normal campaign
roadmap.description: Clear all 16 chapters on Normal, learning the combat system and collecting natural cumulative achievements without interrupting the first story run.

roadmap.title: Amateur cleanup and collections
roadmap.description: Use Chapter Select on Amateur for the second difficulty clear, BSAA Emblems, all treasure types, eggs, combat setups, partner actions, purchases, and upgrade farming.

roadmap.title: Veteran and Lost in Nightmares
roadmap.description: Clear every campaign chapter on Veteran to unlock Professional, then complete the Lost in Nightmares episode, its S rank, Score Stars, Wesker counters, and Professional clear.

roadmap.title: Professional and Desperate Escape
roadmap.description: Finish all main chapters on Professional, then complete the Desperate Escape episode, its S rank, 150-kill run, three Agitators, and Professional clear.

roadmap.title: Versus completion
roadmap.description: Arrange online opponents or a boosting group, buy every Versus character, then finish the four win grinds, two combo targets, two score targets, and 100 physical player kills.

achievements.description: Complete all chapters on Amateur.
achievements.summary: Complete all @mechanic{16 campaign chapters} on Amateur difficulty.

guide.context: Chapter Select records difficulty per chapter, so the Amateur clears may be completed in any order and mixed with collectible cleanup.

steps.text: Open Chapter Select, choose Amateur, and clear every chapter from @loc{1-1} through @loc{6-3}.
Check the Chapter Select difficulty records and replay any chapter that does not show an Amateur clear.

achievements.description: Complete all chapters on Normal.
achievements.summary: Complete all @mechanic{16 campaign chapters} on Normal difficulty.

guide.context: Chapter Select records difficulty per chapter, so a later replay can fill any missing Normal clear without starting a new save.

steps.text: Choose Normal and clear every chapter from @loc{1-1} through @loc{6-3}.
Verify that all 16 Chapter Select entries record a Normal clear.

achievements.description: Complete all chapters on Veteran.
achievements.summary: Complete all @mechanic{16 campaign chapters} on Veteran difficulty.

guide.context: Finishing every Veteran chapter unlocks Professional; chapter order and result rank do not matter.

steps.text: Use Chapter Select to clear @loc{1-1} through @loc{6-3} on Veteran.
Confirm that Professional appears as a selectable campaign difficulty after the final missing Veteran clear.

achievements.description: Complete all chapters on Professional.
achievements.summary: Unlock Professional by clearing Veteran, then complete all @mechanic{16 campaign chapters} on Professional.

guide.context: Professional removes fixed ammunition and grenade pickups, shortens rescue and QTE windows, and makes the Chapter 2-3 turret battle a notable difficulty spike.

steps.text: Clear every chapter on Veteran to unlock Professional difficulty.
Prepare fully upgraded weapons and enable purchased infinite-ammo permissions in Bonus Features if desired.
Use Chapter Select to clear @loc{1-1} through @loc{6-3} on Professional and verify every chapter record.

achievements.description: Find all 4 types of eggs.
achievements.summary: Hold @item{White, Brown, Gold, and Rotten Eggs} in the inventory at the same time.

guide.context: A co-op partner can transfer egg types, but the achievement checks the receiving player's simultaneous inventory rather than lifetime pickups.

collectibles.name: White Egg
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 1-2}, around the chicken near the shotgun building
collectibles.method: Wait near the chicken and pick up a White Egg after the chicken drops one.

collectibles.name: Brown Egg
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 1-2}, around the same chicken area on Amateur
collectibles.method: Replay Chapter 1-2 on Amateur and wait for a chicken to drop a Brown Egg.

collectibles.name: Gold Egg
collectibles.method: Land at the central chicken island, wait among the chickens, and collect the Gold Egg drop.

collectibles.name: Rotten Egg
collectibles.method: Defeat enemies from Chapter 4-1 onward and keep a Rotten Egg when the random drop appears.

achievements.description: Purchase all available alternative costumes in Bonus Features.
achievements.summary: Unlock and purchase every @item{alternate Chris and Sheva costume} from Bonus Features.

guide.context: Campaign completion unlocks the story outfits; 25 BSAA Emblems unlock Chris's S.T.A.R.S. costume and all 30 unlock Sheva's Tribal costume.

steps.text: Complete the campaign and destroy all @item{30 BSAA Emblems}.
Open @mechanic{Bonus Features} and buy every available costume for Chris and Sheva with Battle Points.

achievements.description: Obtain all available weapons.
achievements.summary: Own every campaign weapon, including @item{M93R, Hydra, Gatling Gun, Longbow, and S&W M500}, at the same time.

guide.context: Campaign weapons missed in silver cases become purchasable in Item Management, while five bonus weapons appear only after their linked base weapon is fully upgraded.

steps.text: Collect or buy every standard handgun, shotgun, machine gun, rifle, magnum, launcher, rod, grenade type, and proximity mine.
Fully upgrade @item{M92F, Ithaca M37, VZ61, S75, and S&W M29} to unlock @item{M93R, Hydra, Gatling Gun, Longbow, and S&W M500}.
Buy the five unlocked weapons and move one copy of every weapon type into the inventory together.

achievements.description: Completely upgrade all weapons.
achievements.summary: Max every upgrade category on every @item{upgradable weapon}.

guide.context: Grenade Launcher, Rocket Launcher, Stun Rod, Gatling Gun, and Longbow have no upgrade tracks and therefore need no spending for this achievement.

steps.text: Buy all Firepower, Reload Speed, Capacity, Piercing, and Critical upgrades offered for every standard weapon.
For money, repeat the opening gem route in @loc{Chapter 4-1} or kill the Lickers near the start of @loc{Chapter 5-1} for Lion Hearts.
Return to Item Management after the final available weapon upgrade reaches its maximum level.

achievements.description: Obtain all treasures in the game.
achievements.summary: Obtain all @item{50 unique treasure types} and return to Item Management.

guide.context: The treasure screen deliberately has four blank slots, and the achievement may wait until the inventory update after leaving a chapter.

collectibles.name: 15 object treasures
collectibles.method: Collect Gold Ring, Ivory Relief, Dead Bride's Necklace, Royal Necklace, Jewel Bangle, Venom Fang, Antique Clock, Chalice (Silver), Chalice (Gold), Idol (Silver), Idol (Gold), Ceremonial Mask, Jewel Beetle, Beetle (Brown), and Beetle (Gold). Key sources include the 1-1 Executioner, 1-2 Alysson, 3-1 islands, the 4-2 third mirror puzzle, 5-2 final conveyor, and 5-3 control room.

collectibles.name: 5 Pear gems
collectibles.location: Common campaign drops, plus Diamond (Pear) in @loc{Chapter 2-2}
collectibles.method: Collect Topaz (Pear), Ruby (Pear), Sapphire (Pear), and Emerald (Pear) from the frequent skull, torch, and water pickups, then shoot the sparkle beside the large post-Irving ladder in Chapter 2-2 for Diamond (Pear).

collectibles.name: 5 Square gems
collectibles.location: Common campaign drops, plus Diamond (Square) in @loc{Chapter 2-2}
collectibles.method: Collect Topaz (Square), Ruby (Square), Sapphire (Square), and Emerald (Square) from Chapter 2-2 through 4-2, then descend the left ladder on the post-Irving hillside in Chapter 2-2 for Diamond (Square).

collectibles.name: 5 Oval gems
collectibles.method: Take Diamond (Oval) from the left-wall mine side passage in 2-2, Ruby (Oval) from beneath the fifth statue in 4-1, Sapphire (Oval) from the first side room after Wesker breaks the blue door in 5-3, Emerald (Oval) from the assisted coffin in the next room, and Topaz (Oval) from the crane-route enemies in 6-1.

collectibles.name: 5 Trilliant gems
collectibles.method: Open the early cave chest in 4-1 for Topaz (Trilliant); after the empty-coffin trap, open the surrounding chests for Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald (Trilliant); after inserting all three emblems in 4-2, shoot the sparkle above the next door for Diamond (Trilliant).

collectibles.name: 5 Brilliant gems
collectibles.method: Open the mountain chest after the Irving scene in 2-2 for Diamond (Brilliant); in 5-3 collect Ruby above the post-platform rocks, Topaz above the far drawbridge door, Sapphire from the assisted coffin, and Emerald from the pots at the end of the right-hand upstairs path during the Wesker fight.

collectibles.name: 5 Marquise gems
collectibles.method: Kill the dynamite-throwing Majini during the extended 1-1 horde for Topaz; grenade the market stalls in 2-1 for Ruby; open the drawer between the two 3-3 gun turrets for Emerald; open the safe after the 5-3 fan for Sapphire; as Chris in 6-3, shoot down the rock before the bridge collapses and jump left to it for Diamond.

collectibles.name: 5 special enemy and boss treasures
collectibles.method: Kill a Giant Majini for Blue Enigma, the 4-1 boss for Soul Gem, a Licker for Lion Heart, and a Reaper for Power Stone; during the first Wesker fight in 5-3, force Wesker to retreat and take Heart of Africa between the stairs.

achievements.description: Find all the BSAA emblems.
achievements.summary: Destroy all @item{30 BSAA Emblems} across the campaign.

guide.context: Chapter Select displays each chapter's collected-emblem count; the 30 targets are spread across 12 chapters, so cleanup can be tracked chapter by chapter.

collectibles.name: Chapter 1-2 — 3 emblems
collectibles.method: Shoot the emblem on the southern house wall from its balcony, the emblem near the water tank after climbing the black-goop building, and the emblem beyond the chain-link fence before the final elevator.

collectibles.name: Chapter 2-1 — 5 emblems
collectibles.method: Shoot the starting wall emblem, the emblem on the second bridge support after the truck, the emblem under the green “Charge” booth roof, the emblem on the opposite balcony after the helicopter fight, and the emblem by the broken pillar before Sheva's assist jump.

collectibles.name: Chapter 2-2 — 3 emblems
collectibles.method: Shoot the emblem on the western power pylon from a train roof, the emblem in the waterfall beside the mine bridge, and the emblem on the southeastern roof after leaving Irving's building and climbing the large ladder.

collectibles.name: Chapter 3-1 — 4 emblems
collectibles.method: Use a rifle or boat passenger to shoot the emblem on the cable-linked wooden post, then shoot the emblems under the northwest hut roof, beneath the central chicken shed, and under the exit after opening the plate door.

collectibles.name: Chapter 3-2 — 2 emblems
collectibles.method: Shoot the emblem between the backs of the two Tricell tents, then turn back after the escape timer begins and shoot the emblem through the small dock-house window before running to Josh.

collectibles.name: Chapter 3-3 — 1 emblem
collectibles.method: At the first gate, shoot the emblem beneath the blue metal hut either from the boat or immediately after disembarking.

collectibles.name: Chapter 4-1 — 3 emblems
collectibles.method: Shoot the emblem below the cliff after the first wooden ladder, the emblem beside the central gem before jumping into the tomb, and the emblem high in the rubble across the statue room after the boulder QTE.

collectibles.name: Chapter 4-2 — 1 emblem
collectibles.method: On the third mirror-puzzle floor, enter the trap room containing the corpse, turn around, and shoot the emblem above the doorway.

collectibles.name: Chapter 5-1 — 1 emblem
collectibles.method: Circle right around the opening garden and shoot the emblem beneath the small bridge.

collectibles.name: Chapter 5-2 — 1 emblem
collectibles.method: After the conveyor belt with explosive canisters, descend the stairs and shoot or grenade the emblem inside the first left-hand trash can.

collectibles.name: Chapter 5-3 — 3 emblems
collectibles.method: Shoot the emblem through the fan after the Uroboros room, the emblem beneath an upper platform before starting the circular lift, and the emblem inside the rear elevator shaft in the construction area.

collectibles.name: Chapter 6-1 — 3 emblems
collectibles.method: Use a rifle from the first tower or later crane to shoot the distant stern emblem, throw an explosive into the open shipping container beside the cage switch, and shoot the final emblem in the glass cabinet inside Excella's room.

achievements.description: Collect all the figurines.
achievements.summary: Unlock and purchase all @item{46 Bonus Features figurines}.

guide.context: Extra Content figurines are a separate set and do not count; required unlock conditions include campaign progress, all 30 BSAA Emblems, and chapter ranks.

steps.text: Complete the campaign, destroy all @item{30 BSAA Emblems}, and earn the required A and S ranks across the chapter list.
Open @mechanic{Bonus Features} and buy every one of the 46 figurines with Battle Points.

achievements.description: Save partner 10 times when HELP is displayed.
achievements.summary: Rescue the partner @mechanic{10 times} while HELP is displayed.

guide.context: HELP appears when an enemy has grabbed the partner; these rescues accumulate across campaign play.

steps.text: Wait until an enemy grabs the partner and the HUD changes the partner status to @warn{HELP}.
Move beside the grabbed partner and use the displayed assist action to break the grab; complete 10 credited rescues.

achievements.description: Save partner 10 times when DYING is displayed.
achievements.summary: Revive the partner @mechanic{10 times} while DYING is displayed.

guide.context: A higher difficulty and an AI partner without weapons or healing items creates repeatable downed states, but the player must reach the partner before the rescue window closes.

steps.text: Allow the partner to take lethal damage until the HUD displays @warn{DYING}.
Reach the partner and use the displayed resuscitate action before time expires; complete 10 revives.

achievements.description: Pull off 20 headshots.
achievements.summary: Kill @mechanic{20 enemies} with headshots.

guide.context: Headshot kills accumulate across normal campaign play and need not occur in one chapter.

steps.text: Aim at an enemy's head and fire until the headshot kills the enemy.
Accumulate 20 headshot kills across any campaign chapters.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 enemies with the Knife.
achievements.summary: Kill @mechanic{5 enemies} with the Knife.

guide.context: Small spiders and snakes in Chapter 4-1 count, providing low-risk targets if Majini knife kills are inconvenient.

steps.text: Equip the Knife and land the killing blow on five enemies; use the spiders and snakes near the opening of @loc{Chapter 4-1} for easy targets.

achievements.description: Defeat 30 enemies with the Stun rod.
achievements.summary: Buy the @item{Stun Rod} and kill @mechanic{30 enemies} with it.

guide.context: The Stun Rod costs 3,000, and the Chapter 1-1 mob after the window contains enough weak targets for a focused farm.

steps.text: Purchase and equip the @item{Stun Rod}.
Replay @loc{Chapter 1-1}, reach the large mob after jumping through the window, and kill 30 enemies with Stun Rod final blows.

achievements.description: Defeat 30 enemies with the Gatling gun.
achievements.summary: As Chris, kill @mechanic{30 enemies} with the @item{Gatling Gun}.

guide.context: The Gatling Gun becomes purchasable only after campaign completion and a full VZ61 upgrade; Mercenaries kills also count.

steps.text: Complete the campaign, fully upgrade the @item{VZ61}, and buy the @item{Gatling Gun} for 50,000.
Select Chris and score 30 Gatling Gun kills in the campaign or Mercenaries.

achievements.description: Defeat 30 enemies with the Longbow.
achievements.summary: As Sheva, kill @mechanic{30 enemies} with the @item{Longbow}.

guide.context: The Longbow becomes purchasable only after campaign completion and a full S75 upgrade; Mercenaries kills also count.

steps.text: Complete the campaign, fully upgrade the @item{S75}, and buy the @item{Longbow} for 50,000.
Select Sheva and score 30 Longbow kills in the campaign or Mercenaries.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 enemies with physical attacks.
achievements.summary: Kill @mechanic{20 enemies} with prompted physical attacks.

guide.context: Shooting limbs or the head until an enemy staggers exposes named melee prompts such as Hook, Straight, or Stomp.

steps.text: Stagger a Majini with controlled gunfire without killing the Majini.
Use the displayed physical-attack prompt and ensure the melee strike delivers the kill; accumulate 20 such kills.

achievements.description: Chain the maximum number of combos together in one go.
achievements.summary: Complete a three-hit co-op melee chain on one @enemy{Big Man Majini} and perform the finisher.

guide.context: Only the player who delivers the first strike and the third-hit finisher receives credit, so co-op partners must reverse roles for both players to unlock it.

steps.text: Use a weak shotgun blast to stagger a Big Man Majini while one player stands in front and the other stands behind.
Player one uses the first melee prompt, player two immediately uses the opposite-side follow-up, and player one uses the final special attack.

achievements.description: Defeat a Majini with a headshot while it's jumping.
achievements.summary: Headshot and kill a @enemy{Majini} while the Majini is jumping in Chapter 3-2.

guide.context: After the bridge is destroyed, Majini repeatedly jump between the separated platforms; the Gatling Gun makes the airborne timing more forgiving.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 3-2}, clear the opening wave and remain on the original side after enemies destroy the bridge.
Aim above the gap and kill a Majini with a headshot while the Majini is visibly airborne between platforms.

achievements.description: Shoot an enemy Molotov cocktail, dynamite stick, or hand grenade.
achievements.summary: Shoot a @item{Molotov cocktail, dynamite stick, or hand grenade} while a Chapter 2-1 Majini is holding it.

guide.context: A fixed Majini on a container after the dog area holds an explosive, avoiding the need to wait for a random throw animation.

steps.text: After the dog and container section in @loc{Chapter 2-1}, drop into the area with the Big Man Majini.
Aim at the Molotov cocktail, dynamite stick, or grenade held by the Majini on the container behind the Big Man and shoot the explosive.

achievements.description: Deflect a bow gun arrow with your knife.
achievements.summary: Deflect a @enemy{crossbow Majini} arrow with the Knife in Chapter 2-1.

guide.context: The first crossbow user appears in Chapter 2-1, and only the Knife swing timing matters; the arrow need not be redirected into another enemy.

steps.text: Face the first crossbow Majini in @loc{Chapter 2-1} with the Knife ready.
Watch the incoming arrow and swing the Knife immediately before the projectile reaches the player.

achievements.description: Defeat 3 Majini with one grenade or proximity bomb.
achievements.summary: Kill @mechanic{3 Majini at once} with one Hand Grenade or Proximity Bomb.

guide.context: The final Chapter 1-1 ambush produces a dense mob and can be replayed through Chapter Select.

steps.text: During the final ambush in @loc{Chapter 1-1}, kite at least three Majini into a tight cluster.
Place one Proximity Bomb in their path or throw one Hand Grenade at the center and ensure the single blast kills all three.

achievements.description: Defeat 2 enemies with one flash grenade.
achievements.summary: Kill @mechanic{2 enemies at once} with one Flash Grenade.

guide.context: Chapter 4-1 spiders die instantly to flash damage, so the group after the opening ladder is more reliable than weakened Majini.

steps.text: Climb the opening ladder in @loc{Chapter 4-1} and wait for at least two spiders to gather.
Throw one Flash Grenade into the spider group and kill at least two with the flash.

achievements.description: Defeat a Majini using the electric current from a transformer.
achievements.summary: Kill a @enemy{Majini} with current from the fallen transformer in Chapter 1-1.

guide.context: The transformer remains dangerous after falling; additional shots make the unit discharge again if the initial impact does not kill the target.

steps.text: During the final @loc{Chapter 1-1} ambush, wait for the Executioner to break the gate and shoot down the transformer beyond it.
Lure a Majini beside the fallen transformer and shoot the transformer until an electrical discharge kills the Majini.

achievements.description: Defeat 3 Majini at once by setting oil canisters on fire.
achievements.summary: Burn and kill @mechanic{3 Majini at once} with the Chapter 1-1 oil canisters.

guide.context: The canisters sit beyond the gate broken by the Executioner, where the pursuing mob naturally bunches together.

steps.text: During the final @loc{Chapter 1-1} ambush, pass the broken gate and gather at least three Majini beside the oil canisters on the left.
Shoot the oil canisters and ensure the resulting fire kills all three Majini together.

achievements.description: Defeat 3 Majini at once with a drum or gas tank explosion.
achievements.summary: Kill @mechanic{3 Majini at once} with a drum or gas-tank explosion.

guide.context: After the approaching truck is destroyed in Chapter 2-1, several Majini advance between explosive barrels on the bridge.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 2-1}, destroy the approaching truck and wait for at least three following Majini to move beside one bridge barrel.
Shoot the barrel or gas tank and ensure the single explosion kills all three Majini.

achievements.description: Work together to save someone special.
achievements.summary: Remove Jill's chest device while Jill is standing during the Chapter 5-3 rescue.

guide.context: Pulling the device while Jill lies on the floor completes the fight but does not satisfy this co-op-action condition.

steps.text: After Wesker leaves the @loc{Chapter 5-3} fight, repeatedly use Chris's reason prompt until the partner restrains Jill.
Shoot the chest device during restraints until the device sparks, then reason with Jill again.
While the partner holds Jill upright, grab the device and complete the pull prompt without using the floor-removal route.

achievements.description: During the first fight with Wesker, damage him a set number of times.
achievements.summary: Deal enough damage to @enemy{Wesker} within the first Chapter 5-3 fight to force his retreat.

guide.context: The encounter ends after seven minutes even without enough damage; losing Wesker's line of sight creates the opening needed to attack his otherwise evasive stance.

steps.text: Enter the first @loc{Chapter 5-3} Wesker fight with an upgraded magnum and move to the blue door so Wesker kicks the player through it.
Run upstairs until Wesker's map marker begins searching, then attack from behind and repeat until Wesker retreats before the timer ends.
Pick up the @item{Heart of Africa} between the stairs before leaving the arena.

achievements.description: Stop an armored truck by taking out the driver.
achievements.summary: Stop the second armored truck in Chapter 2-3 by killing its driver.

guide.context: The driver is protected by breakable armor over the side window, so shooting the truck body alone does not satisfy the condition.

steps.text: During @loc{Chapter 2-3}, destroy the first truck that approaches from the left.
When the second truck approaches from the right, shoot away the armor covering the driver-side window, then kill the exposed driver before impact.

achievements.description: Defeat a Majini with a rotten egg.
achievements.summary: Kill a weakened @enemy{Majini} by throwing a @item{Rotten Egg}.

guide.context: Rotten Eggs are random enemy drops from Chapter 4-1 onward; save one instead of selling it for this cleanup.

steps.text: Choose Amateur in @loc{Chapter 1-2}, reach the female Majini, and weaken her with one handgun shot.
Equip a @item{Rotten Egg}, throw the egg at the wounded Majini, and ensure the impact delivers the kill.

achievements.description: Defeat a certain enemy by stabbing it in the heart.
achievements.summary: Knock a @enemy{Licker} onto its back and kill it with the heart-stab prompt.

guide.context: The first Chapter 5-1 encounter contains only two Lickers, giving more time to reach the short execution prompt.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 5-1}, use a shotgun at close range to knock one of the first two Lickers onto its back.
Rush to the downed Licker before it rises and use the displayed heart-stab action.

achievements.description: Build up a certain level of trust with your partner.
achievements.summary: Raise Sheva's AI trust by thanking her after repeated heals in solo play.

guide.context: Human co-op does not use the AI trust system, and the “Thanks!” response after a partner action is the part that raises the relevant value.

steps.text: Start solo @loc{Chapter 1-2} with healing items, shoot the transformer down, stand beside it, and knife the unit to damage Chris.
Allow AI Sheva to heal Chris, then use the @mechanic{“Thanks!”} response immediately.
Repeat the self-damage, heal, and thanks cycle until the trust achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Win 30 matches in Slayers.
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{30 online Slayers matches}.

guide.context: Public Versus matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange human opponents or a boosting group in advance. Slayers matches last three minutes and the game provides no win counter, so an external tally prevents extra rounds.

steps.text: Start online Versus in @mechanic{Slayers} and finish each round with the highest score.
Record each victory outside the game and reach 30 Slayers wins.

achievements.description: Win 30 matches in Survivors.
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{30 online Survivors matches}.

guide.context: Public Versus matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange human opponents or a boosting group in advance. Survivors rounds start at five minutes and can run longer when players break time bonuses; the game provides no win counter.

steps.text: Start online Versus in @mechanic{Survivors} and finish each round with the highest score.
Record each victory outside the game and reach 30 Survivors wins.

achievements.description: Win 30 matches in Team Slayers.
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{30 online Team Slayers matches}.

guide.context: Team Versus requires a four-player human lobby, and public matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange a boosting group in advance. Team mode credits the match result rather than individual placement, so coordinate enemy kills and avoid feeding the opposing team.

steps.text: Form a Versus team, select @mechanic{Team Slayers}, and finish each round with the higher team score.
Record and reach 30 Team Slayers victories.

achievements.description: Win 30 matches in Team Survivors.
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{30 online Team Survivors matches}.

guide.context: Team Versus requires a four-player human lobby, and public matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange a boosting group in advance. Time bonuses can extend the five-minute base round, and the achievement has no visible win counter.

steps.text: Form a Versus team, select @mechanic{Team Survivors}, and finish each round with the higher team score.
Record and reach 30 Team Survivors victories.

achievements.description: Chain a 20-defeated combo in Slayers.
achievements.summary: Build a continuous @mechanic{20-kill combo} in one online Slayers match.

guide.context: Public Versus matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange human opponents or a boosting group in advance. A shotgun or rifle on the compact Public Assembly map helps secure quick kills before the combo timer expires, but opponents can interrupt the chain.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Slayers}, locate enemies with the radar, and kill Majini in rapid succession.
Reach a displayed 20-defeated combo without allowing the combo timer to reset.

achievements.description: Chain a 40-defeated combo in Team Slayers.
achievements.summary: Build a continuous shared @mechanic{40-kill combo} in one online Team Slayers match.

guide.context: Team Versus requires a four-player human lobby, and public matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange a boosting group in advance. Both teammates contribute to the same chain, so alternate nearby targets and call out delays before the combo timer expires.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Team Slayers} with a coordinated teammate and use the radar to keep both players near new Majini.
Combine team kills until the displayed chain reaches 40 without a timer reset.

achievements.description: Score at least 40,000 points in Survivors.
achievements.summary: Score at least @mechanic{40,000 points} in one online Survivors match.

guide.context: Public Versus matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange human opponents or a boosting group in advance. Public Assembly is compact, and physical finishers on staggered opponents award useful bonus points when scarce high-value weapons are unavailable.

steps.text: Choose @loc{Public Assembly} in Survivors and use the radar to find the opposing player quickly.
Damage opponents, finish staggered opponents with close-range physical attacks, and reach 40,000 points before the match ends.

achievements.description: Score at least 80,000 points in Team Survivors.
achievements.summary: Score at least @mechanic{80,000 combined points} in one online Team Survivors match.

guide.context: Team Versus requires a four-player human lobby, and public matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange a boosting group in advance. The threshold uses the team total, so coordinated downs and physical finishers are more efficient than teammates competing for the same target.

steps.text: Choose @loc{Public Assembly} in Team Survivors and split radar coverage with the teammate.
Coordinate opponent kills and finishing moves until the team score reaches 80,000 before the match ends.

achievements.description: Unlock all selectable characters in Versus.
achievements.summary: Purchase all @item{8 selectable Versus characters} from Bonus Features.

guide.context: All eight character purchases cost 134,000 Battle Points in total, making campaign rank runs and treasure farming useful preparation.

steps.text: Earn at least @mechanic{134,000 Battle Points} through campaign results and other score awards.
Open @mechanic{Bonus Features} and buy all eight Versus character entries.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 players using physical attacks in Versus.
achievements.summary: Kill @mechanic{100 opposing players} with Versus physical finishers.

guide.context: Public Versus matchmaking is sparse and region-limited, so arrange human opponents or a boosting group in advance. A player becomes vulnerable to the finisher after health is depleted and the character begins staggering; ordinary Majini melee kills do not count.

steps.text: In any online Versus mode, damage an opposing player until the opponent enters the staggered state.
Move into close range, use the displayed physical finisher, and accumulate 100 player kills delivered by that action.

achievements.description: Complete "Lost in Nightmares" on any difficulty setting.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Lost in Nightmares} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Lost in Nightmares appears under Play Game > Extra Content after campaign completion and does not offer mid-episode save-and-continue.

steps.text: Finish the campaign once so @loc{Lost in Nightmares} appears in the Extra Content menu.
Open @mechanic{Play Game > Extra Content > Lost in Nightmares}, choose any difficulty, and finish the episode through its result screen.

achievements.description: Complete "Lost in Nightmares" with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Lost in Nightmares} with an S rank on any difficulty.

guide.context: The final grade combines time, accuracy, enemy kills, and Score Star or treasure points; killing at least four Guardians is a workable kill target.

steps.text: Choose Amateur or Normal, aim carefully, destroy Score Stars, collect point items from small creatures, and kill at least four Guardians.
Finish the episode quickly without deaths and obtain an overall S on the result screen.

achievements.description: Complete "Lost in Nightmares" on Professional.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Lost in Nightmares} on Veteran, then finish the episode on Professional.

guide.context: Professional unlocks separately for this episode after a Veteran clear; its prison Guardians are faster and the emblem door requires all four fragments.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Lost in Nightmares} once on Veteran to unlock the episode's Professional setting.
Start Lost in Nightmares on Professional, collect all four prison emblem fragments, survive the Wesker encounter, and finish the episode.

achievements.description: Inflict a set amount of damage to Wesker in "Lost in Nightmares."
achievements.summary: Land repeated counterattacks on @enemy{Wesker} during Lost in Nightmares until he retreats.

guide.context: Normal provides more encounter time than Amateur, and Jill's taunt can help provoke the charge that exposes a counter prompt.

steps.text: During the final @loc{Lost in Nightmares} encounter, create distance and shoot Wesker twice to provoke his charge.
Use the dodge prompt, then immediately use Jill's or Chris's counterattack prompt.
Repeat the charge, dodge, and counter cycle until the damage threshold is met before Wesker leaves.

achievements.description: Destroy all 18 of the Score stars found throughout "Lost in Nightmares."
achievements.summary: Destroy all @item{18 Score Stars} during one Lost in Nightmares playthrough.

guide.context: Score Stars do not persist like BSAA Emblems: all 18 must be broken in the same episode run, although either co-op player may shoot them.

collectibles.name: Entrance windows
collectibles.method: Move forward from the start, turn back, and shoot the star above the entrance beside the broken windows.

collectibles.name: Lever lamp
collectibles.method: Find the lever behind the main stairs and shoot the star attached to the ceiling lamp on the grille side.

collectibles.name: Chandelier
collectibles.method: After pulling the lever, go upstairs, turn right, walk to the corridor end, and look back at the chandelier.

collectibles.name: Bedroom-corridor dishes
collectibles.method: Enter the nearby upper-floor door, stop before the bedroom, and shoot the star on the right-hand furniture behind the dishes.

collectibles.name: Upper dining-room wall
collectibles.method: Help Jill cross the broken upper corridor, then shoot the star high in the upper-right corner of the second-floor dining room.

collectibles.name: Clock pendulum
collectibles.method: Inspect the large broken clock and shoot the star behind its pendulum.

collectibles.name: Toilet shelf
collectibles.method: Take the corridor beside the stairs into the toilet room and shoot the star on the upper shelf along the left wall.

collectibles.name: Covered cage
collectibles.method: Pass through the two corridors after opening the emblem door and shoot the star inside the lower right-hand cage behind the cloth.

collectibles.name: Computer safe room
collectibles.location: @loc{Secret room opened by the computer passwords}
collectibles.method: After the secret door opens, approach slowly and shoot the high wall star before entering the safe room.

collectibles.name: Padlock-room ceiling
collectibles.method: Have the trapped character shoot the padlock through the grille; enter with the other character, turn left, and shoot the ceiling star.

collectibles.name: Crank-route wall
collectibles.method: Use the crank in the main hall, pass through the opened door, and shoot the star on the right wall before or after jumping down.

collectibles.name: Fifth cell corpse
collectibles.method: Continue from the crank-route star and enter the fifth right-hand cell; shoot the star on the floor beside the corpse.

collectibles.name: Torture-hall wall
collectibles.method: Enter the large hall after passing the tortured prisoners, turn left, and shoot the star fixed to the wall.

collectibles.name: Upper first cell
collectibles.method: Climb the stairs, turn right, and shoot the star on the back wall of the first cell on the right.

collectibles.name: First Guardian room
collectibles.location: @loc{Room containing the first Guardian on Amateur}
collectibles.method: At the prison dead end beside the wall the Guardian breaks, check beneath the furniture and destroy the star on the floor.

collectibles.name: Cell beyond the broken wall
collectibles.method: Cross through the wall broken by the Guardian, turn left, and shoot the star behind the bars.

collectibles.name: Emblem-fragment grille
collectibles.method: At the foot of the left-side stairs, inspect the wall recesses and shoot the star behind one grille.

collectibles.name: Dungeon-exit wall
collectibles.method: Climb the exit stairs, take the weapon near the bodies if needed, turn back, and shoot the star high on the left wall.

achievements.description: Complete "Desperate Escape" on any difficulty setting.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Desperate Escape} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Desperate Escape appears under Play Game > Extra Content after the campaign and follows Jill and Josh's escape.

steps.text: Finish the campaign once so @loc{Desperate Escape} appears in the Extra Content menu.
Open @mechanic{Play Game > Extra Content > Desperate Escape}, choose any difficulty, and finish the episode through its result screen.

achievements.description: Complete "Desperate Escape" with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Desperate Escape} with an S rank and at least 80,000 total score.

guide.context: The overall grade can compensate for one weaker category; combining the run with 150 personal kills strongly improves the enemies-killed score.

steps.text: Choose Amateur, remove the AI partner's weapon, maintain accuracy, collect time bonuses, and personally kill at least 150 enemies.
Finish Desperate Escape with 80,000 or more total points and confirm an overall S on the result screen.

achievements.description: Complete "Desperate Escape" on Professional.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Desperate Escape} on Veteran, then finish the episode on Professional.

guide.context: The episode unlocks Professional after a Veteran clear, although joining a host who already selected Professional can bypass that personal unlock.

steps.text: Complete Desperate Escape on Veteran or join a host with the episode's Professional difficulty available.
Secure the shotgun in the opening area and a magnum before the final defense, then finish the entire episode on Professional.

achievements.description: Defeat 150 enemies singlehandedly in one playthrough of "Desperate Escape."
achievements.summary: Personally kill @mechanic{150 enemies} in one Desperate Escape playthrough.

guide.context: Partner kills do not count toward the personal total, so Amateur with the AI partner disarmed protects the available enemy pool.

steps.text: Start @loc{Desperate Escape} on Amateur and remove every weapon from the AI partner.
Kill every enemy personally and continue spawning waves until the 150th credited kill occurs before the episode ends.

achievements.description: Defeat 3 Agitator Majini in one playthrough of "Desperate Escape."
achievements.summary: Kill all @enemy{3 white-megaphone Agitator Majini} in one Desperate Escape playthrough.

guide.context: Big Man Majini carrying megaphones do not count; each real Agitator receives an introductory cutscene and appears only after its area's enemy waves are sufficiently cleared.

steps.text: In the opening area, clear every room and enemy before the exit, cross the co-op ladder, then return after the cutscene and kill the first Agitator.
At the two rocket-launcher turrets, do not open Josh's route; clear every enemy including the opposite platform until the second Agitator appears there, then kill him.
During the final defense, kill every elevator and drop-in enemy through the second timer and kill the third Agitator immediately when he appears near the end.
